git.benchmark_adapter_hash: none; direct public StatePlane API with isolated SQLite backends

protocol.scope: one isolated SQLite-backed StatePlane per conversation
protocol.metrics: Hit@5, evidence recall@5, normalized binary NDCG@5

environment.hardware: 8 requested physical CPU cores, 16 GiB requested memory
environment.storage: ephemeral isolated SQLite database per conversation

limitations: This is a clean retrieval component lane, not the official end-to-end LoCoMo QA score.
The official QA path uses model generation and category-specific answer evaluation; this runner does not replace that judge.
The component uses isolated conversation scope rather than global retrieval; those lanes must not be compared directly.
The runner ingests raw turns only and does not index official observation/session summaries or QA answers.
The public StatePlane hybrid path is used as configured by the baseline environment; no benchmark-specific embedding or projection is added by this runner.
Nine dataset QA rows were excluded because they had no usable source evidence after the frozen parser; the excluded count is recorded rather than silently treated as a hit.
disallowed_claims: Do not call 0.411229 Hit@5, 0.376139 evidence recall, or 0.308134 NDCG official LoCoMo QA accuracy, SOTA, or #1.
Do not compare this StatePlane raw-turn component lane to the prior projection-enriched component lane as a like-for-like score.
Do not infer end-to-end answer quality from retrieval evidence metrics.
